items.title: Mining giants drive ASX to seven-week high
items.summary: Mining heavyweights BHP and Rio Tinto have helped lift the ASX 200 to a seven-week high, buoyed by a strong Wall Street lead from the Anthropic IPO.

items.title: Nvidia Plays Kingmaker Again. Why the Meta Deal Is a Winning Move.
items.summary: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta Platforms as part of a larger partnership.

items.title: Boeing stock sinks 10% as company says it won't significantly ramp up 737 Max production until late 2027
items.summary: Boeing is set to brief investors on its aircraft production outlook when it reports quarterly results before the market opens Tuesday.

aus.headline: ASX Hits Seven-Week High
aus.body: Big miners BHP and Rio Tinto drove the ASX 200 to its best level in seven weeks.
aus.why: Miners are some of the largest companies on the local share market.

us.headline: Nvidia Puts $3b Into Meta
us.body: The chip maker is backing Meta with $3 billion under a broader tie-up.
us.why: Deals between AI giants shape the tech stocks many Aussies hold.

biz.headline: Boeing Shares Sink 10%
biz.body: Boeing fell 10% after saying 737 Max output won't rise much until late 2027.
biz.why: Slower jet output affects airlines worldwide, including here.
